ticks.note: Each tick is one second later than the last (`deltaT = 1000`). Tick 1 enters `Off`.
Pressed. The root's clock has been running since tick 1 (it says 1000 here before the transition), so the transition resets it: `t` = 0, `light` on.
The clock advances in `On` just as it did in `Off`: `t` = 1000.
Pressed again. The clock first advances to 3000, then the self-loop (priority 1) resets it: `t` = 0. The five seconds start again.
`t` = 5000: the timeout fires in this tick and `light` goes off, five seconds after the second press.
The clock is never stopped: it keeps counting in `Off` (`t` = 6000). That is why the transition into `On` resets it.
